sql: SELECT 'g1' g, main_cat, COUNT(*) n FROM items_g1 GROUP BY main_cat UNION ALL SELECT 'g2', main_cat, COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 GROUP BY main_cat UNION ALL SELECT 'g3', main_cat, COUNT(*) FROM items_g3 GROUP BY main_cat;
SELECT g, SUM(n) total FROM (SELECT 'g1' g, COUNT(*) n FROM items_g1 UNION ALL SELECT 'g2', COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 UNION ALL SELECT 'g3', COUNT(*) FROM items_g3) GROUP BY g;
SELECT 'g1' g, main_cat, COUNT(*) n FROM items_g1 GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT 'g2' g, main_cat, COUNT(*) n FROM items_g2 GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT 'g3' g, main_cat, COUNT(*) n FROM items_g3 GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN prc_usd IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nulls, SUM(CASE WHEN prc_usd=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zeros, SUM(CASE WHEN prc=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zeros_prc, MIN(prc_usd), MAX(prc_usd) FROM items_g2;
SELECT prc, prc_usd, COUNT(*) n FROM items_g2 GROUP BY prc, prc_usd LIMIT 20;
SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN prc_usd IS NULL AND prc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) both_null, SUM(CASE WHEN prc_usd IS NULL AND prc IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) usd_null_prc_not FROM items_g2;
SELECT ref_id, ttl, str_nm, main_cat, prc, prc_usd FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd IS NULL AND prc IS NOT NULL LIMIT 15;

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(prc_usd - prc/100.0) > 0.0001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd IS NOT NULL AND prc IS NOT NULL;
SELECT DISTINCT str_nm FROM items_g2 WHERE main_cat='All Electronics' LIMIT 20;
SELECT MAX(prc) maxprc_populated, MIN(prc) minprc_populated FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd IS NOT NULL;
SELECT MIN(prc) min_prc_nullusd FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd IS NULL AND prc IS NOT NULL;
SELECT MIN(prc) min_g1, MAX(prc) max_g1 FROM items_g1 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL;
SELECT MIN(prc) min_g3, MAX(prc) max_g3 FROM items_g3 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc>0;
WITH t AS (SELECT prc/100.0 AS p, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY prc) rn, COUNT(*) OVER () c FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc>0) SELECT AVG(p) FROM t WHERE rn IN ((c+1)/2, (c+2)/2);
WITH t AS (SELECT prc_usd AS p, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY prc_usd) rn, COUNT(*) OVER () c FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd>0) SELECT AVG(p) FROM t WHERE rn IN ((c+1)/2, (c+2)/2);
WITH t AS (SELECT prc AS p, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY prc) rn, COUNT(*) OVER () c FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc>0) SELECT rn, p FROM t WHERE rn IN ((c+1)/2, (c+2)/2);
SELECT COUNT(*) n_prc_ge_50000, SUM(CASE WHEN prc_usd IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_usd FROM items_g2 WHERE prc>=50000;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT prc/100.0 AS price,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY prc) rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER () c
  FROM items_g2
  WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc > 0
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS median_price_usd
FROM t WHERE rn IN ((c+1)/2, (c+2)/2);
